selection.warning: Median gas fraction Mgas/M* of the FIRE-2 high-redshift zoom galaxies at z=5 in stellar mass bins with at least five galaxies (solid squares, left panel), read from the vector paths of Marszewski et al. 2024; no table exists. Error bars are the plotted 16th-84th percentiles of the galaxies in the bin (a scatter, not an error of the median); where a bar runs off the plotted range its end is not recorded. Mass and gas are within 0.2 Rvir of central galaxies with M* > 1e6 Msun (satellites and halos contaminated by low-resolution particles excluded). The individual galaxies, the open squares (bins with fewer than five galaxies), the authors' best-fit lines and the Mgas/(M*+Mgas) panel are not extracted. Zoom-in sample, not a volume.
